description: A Flutter provider class managing medical records state, including loading records for a patient and fetching individual records by ID, utilizing a MedicalRecordService for data retrieval.

classes.name: MedicalRecordProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based provider managing medical record data and state for a Flutter app.

methods.name: loadForPatient
methods.description: Loads medical records for a specified patient ID, updating internal state and handling errors.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a specific medical record by its ID, updating internal state and handling errors.

methods.name: _setLoading
methods.description: Sets the loading flag and notifies listeners.
